title: Horton Spring 2022 Finals 1: Urchin, Fortress, Save, Barracks

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Spring 2022 Tournament Summary; Finals kingdom 1 (first designed for Winter 2019)

quality_note: Designer explains the key resources (Save against Urchin, the Mercenary split, Familiar as a trap) but gives no build order; he calls it a slugfest.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening.

edition: Horse Traders (first edition of Cornucopia, current in 2022).
